run_xbox_controller_teleop: run the Xbox controller teleoperation script for the Stretch robot with recording enabled
create_stretch_kinematics_model: create a HelloStretchKinematics model from a URDF file for the Stretch robot
record_robot_state: create a Recorder instance to capture robot state data to an HDF5 file
convert_pngs_to_mp4: convert recorded PNG frames from an HDF5 file into an MP4 video
init_xbox_controller_with_recorder: initialize a StretchXboxController that starts recording on first joystick input
